description: NASA Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS, a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "energy", published or maintained by NASA. NASA's goal in Earth science is to observe, understand, and model the Earth system to discover how it is changing, to better predict change, and to understand the consequences for life on Earth. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag energy and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: Near Real Time (NRT); as soon as source data becomes available from our source data providers. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons BY 4.0 (as given on the registry page). Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws.
